_meta.spec: pooled OLS, log10(acres+1) ~ z(PDSI)+z(temp)+z(precip) May-Oct + state FE; leave-one-year-out CV; baseline = state climatology (train-years median)
_meta.honesty: Prior art ceiling: Riley et al. 2013 PDSI-area R^2 ~ 0.25. This model explains state identity (FE) + a modest climate signal; it is a seasonal risk indicator, not a forecast of individual fires.
